user.title: Set up Battery Lifetime
user.description:
Battery Lifetime auto-discovers every numeric percent battery sensor in Home Assistant and creates around nine companion entities per battery (replace-by, drain rate, profile, threshold, etc.).

Setup itself completes within seconds. Once setup finishes, a one-time cold-start backfill runs in the background, scanning long-term statistics for each battery's most recent replacement to seed the 'Replaced on' date. On installs with many batteries (50+) this background scan can take several minutes — the integration is fully functional throughout, and a persistent notification will appear when the backfill finishes.

You can opt out individual batteries from the integration's options afterwards. Press Submit to continue.
